title: The powers were powering tonight
content: Anyone else have an incredibly lucid visit this past night? I’m talking tall glass and metal cityscapes, super long and steep escalators within fancy over the top lobby’s with many many balconies and levels and… the powers ! I’ve never had so much control over my flight, but tonight I was able to jump and leap from many roofs/balconies/overhangs and during the fall, stop, look around, and shoot off very fast in any direction I wanted. Moving like the flash but in flight and even though I was super fast, it all felt…slow. With multicolored light trails or something. Lots of scenes in what feels like a huge underground terminal of some sort. Many many escalators (long golden steep ones) that go up and down to different levels and ticket areas… also many interactions with the people of the city whether just waving at them, flying past them shocking and surprising them.. or simply flying away and evading their policing forces. I dunno, it was a powerful one.
